'''Brugiss''' was a company that produced [[C/ln ion cannon/Legends|C/ln ion cannons]], one of which was used on the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray''-class patrol craft]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].
